title: Three-Variable XOR Realization using IC 7400 & IC 7427
description: Implement the 3-variable XOR function F(A, B, C) = A ⊕ B ⊕ C using a cascaded structure F = (A ⊕ B) ⊕ C. Construct the first stage  X = A ⊕ B using NAND logic (IC 7400) and complete the second stage using IC 7400 and IC 7427. Map inputs A, B, C to SW0, SW1, SW2 respectively, and output F to LED0.
author: Jarin, Tabassum
hints: Break the 3-input XOR into two stages: X = A ⊕ B, then F = X ⊕ C.
Use 4 2-input NAND gates from one IC 7400 to form the first 2-input XOR sub-circuit X = A ⊕ B.
For IC 7427, you can tie any unused 3rd input of a 3-input NOR gate to GND (0) to use it as a standard 2-input NOR gate.
Cascade X and C through the remaining gates on IC 7400 and IC 7427 to produce the final output F.
